review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.location: Quezon City, National Capital Region, Philippines
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Location: West Trade Center Building, Quezon City, Philippines Key Responsibilities: Monitor network performance, maintain high availability, and ensure the reliability and security of network infrastructure. Install, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain routers, switches, firewalls, and wireless access points. Manage and troubleshoot LAN, WAN, VPN, and wireless connectivity. Administer and support A10 load balancers, Cisco ISE, remote access policies, and certificate lifecycle management. Moni
eligibility_evidence: Experience with Azure networking, ExpressRoute, VPN, and hybrid connectivity.
Willingness to provide occasional onsite support at data centers and participate in after-hours support when required.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Key Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Networking, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience. 5–8 years of experience in network engineering, network operations, or a related technical role. Hands-on experience with Cisco networking technologies, particularly Cisco ACI and Nexus switches, is preferred. You'll be part of a dynamic, global IT team where your technical expertise directly supports network reliability, security, and operational excellence.
